<result>All four items landed in `framework/gpu/3d.zig`, committed as **c81d79403**. No new host door was needed — `framework/v8_bindings_core.zig` untouched.

**What landed (framework/gpu/3d.zig):**

1. **Stage grid (req_2618 A / req_2623)** — constants ~L2420-2440 (`STAGE_*`; basis documented as 1 tile = 1 m = 16 u, matching model_paint's Blockbench-16x texels-per-meter and the studio config gridTiles 3 / unitsPerTile 16 / fineDivisions 16); `drawStagePanels`/`drawStageLines`/`stageLine` ~L2755-2810. 3×3 one-tile panels (center brighter), 16×16 fine center sub-grid (dimmer), world axes from origin in the `axisColor` convention. Drawn whenever the model doc view is active (`g_me_capture` + target), no selection needed.
2. **Face/edge/vertex dressing (req_2618 B)** — `drawFaceTintOverlay` (translucent per-face wash, front-facing only, selected = stronger orange), `drawFaceDotsOverlay` (area-weighted centroid dot per AUTHORED face — the studio signature), `drawEdgeOverlay` (all boundary edges; dim pass now also in face mode; selected edges bold orange), ~L2825-2990. All pure overlay polys/capsules — atlas and vertex colors never touched, so the req_2611/2613 bake class is impossible here. Layering fixed via scissor-segment breaks (`overlayLayerBreak`) since polys draw after capsules within a segment; overlay is now also clipped to the pane and gated to the pane that owns the edit target (fixes the thumbnail-smear noted in engine.zig).
3. **Gizmo sizing (req_2620 V / req_2619 Q)** — `selectionScreenRadiusPx`/`gizmoBasePx`/`gizmoAxisGeom` ~L2530-2600: axis length scales with selection's projected extent, clamped 46-170 px; per-axis growth up to 1.9× when the axis is near screen-parallel; foreshortening compensation floored at perp 0.35; handle dots shrunk to 7/9 px, pivot 6 px. `meshGizmoDrag` move now maps world-units-per-pixel through the drawn handle (side-on = finer). Ring draw + `ringHitDist2` share `gizmoRingWorldR`; hit-testing uses the same `axisEndpoint`, so draw/hit stay consistent.
4. **Loop-cut visibility (req_2625 CC/DD)** — `LcSession` gained `sel_center` + last previewed comb (recorded in `meshLoopCutFacePreview` ~L1170); `drawEdgeOverlay` accents edges lying in a previewed cut plane in cyan; `drawLoopCutOverlay` draws a translate-style axis-colored handle on the middle cut plane.

**Verified headless** (never the desktop; `SHIP_RUN_PACKAGE=0 ./tools/rjit ship editor` then `rjit shot`, PNGs read and confirmed; all in `/tmp/claude-1000/-home-siah-creative-reactjit/40eebdf5-ae0f-4114-b3f9-c2c8545b2b9f/scratchpad/`):
- `RJIT_MODELDOC=cube` → `t1_grid_base.png` + `t1_zoom_floor.png`: panels, tile lines, fine center grid, RGB axes visible.
- `RJIT_SELECTFACE=2` → `t2_facemode.png`: all edges + centroid dots + compact non-blob gizmo on a 1-face selection.
- `RJIT_MESHMODE=2` → `t3_edgemode.png`: crisp 12-edge cube. `RJIT_MESHMODE=1` → `t4_vertmode.png`: vertex dots.
- `RJIT_MESHOPS="mode:3;sel:4;gizmo:2"` → `t5_rotate.png`: selection-scaled rotate rings. `range:0,64` → `t6_bigsel.png`: whole-cube selection grows the axes well past the cube (policy visibly working).
- `RJIT_SELECTEDGE=0 RJIT_EDGEOP=loopcut` → `t7_loopcut.png`: cut loop clearly visible (TRI 12→28).

**Notes/blockers:**
- Mid-verification another agent's in-flight edit to `cart/editor/stage/ModelView.tsx` had a transient esbuild syntax error, so `rjit shot`'s staleness rebuild failed; I ran the identical self-capture command (`ZIGOS_HEADLESS=1 ZIGOS_SCREENSHOT=1 …`) against my already-built binary for t4-t7. Not my breakage; likely already fixed by that agent.
- The live lc-session accent/handle can't be screenshot-driven headlessly: RJIT_MESHOPS has no ops for `__mesh_lc_begin/preview/end`. Cart-side follow-up suggested: add `lcbegin/lcprev:d,c,off/lcend:N` ops to ModelView's meshops harness. Wiring an actual drag on the lc handle also needs cart-side popup changes (noted, not hacked in).</result>
